body:
# _AAAEEEEEEEE MODPACK: ABNORMALS AND MORE_
_AAA its just a modpack to play with friends, if you want._

- adds create aeroo + burn
- clouds
- farmers delight
- more enemies on born in chaos
- galosphere
- complementary shaders
- and MORE

### _ABOUT_
I wanted to keep it as vanilla as possibl so, there are some abnormals mods included, it have some many bosses, biomes, and oother improvements, the thing its that you can explore and discover what it have.

some of the additions are not entirely abnormal, but i tried to make all feel, the most minecraftic as i could, so if something it's not entirely abnormal at least it looks good

### _NEOFORGE_
Its made only for neoforge because, i really want create aeronauticss, a bad thing because i want some fabric mods (i know that we have opcions for compatibility with neoforege, but i have some issues, so i'll maybe add it on other version).


### _PERFORMANCE_
The modpack its kinda heavy, it have some performance mods, like lithium and ferritecore, and others, not that heavy as ice and fire, or as dimentions mods, but if you have a bad resources pc i dont recommend it.

### _NOTES_
You MUST have both vanilla clouds and shader clouds turned off for clouds mod
